barishh.blurb: A modern Indian restaurant on the 4th floor of South City Mall, with a nature-themed interior, open about 12:30 to 11 pm.

tips.expect: Creatively named dishes in a colourful, nature-themed room. About ₹1,500 for two, rated about 4.4.
tips.tip: A good sit-down meal after the Jadavpur pandals.

mqxt.blurb: A budget-friendly cafe on Sarat Bose Road, Lake Terrace, listed for burgers, Chinese and fast food at about ₹600 for two.

tips.expect: A casual, affordable place for groups.
tips.watch: Listings describe it more as a burger and fast-food spot than the European deli its name suggests.
tips.tip: Handy near the Lake Market cafes.

wafira.blurb: A lounge with Moroccan interiors and a handcrafted bar menu, at 13 Ho Chi Minh Sarani.

tips.expect: A stylish lounge with finger food and mixed cuisines. About ₹1,200 for two.
tips.tip: Part of the Ho Chi Minh Sarani cluster with Cove, Mehico and Sorano.

makati-kolkata.blurb: The on-site fine-dining restaurant at the Golden Parkk hotel on Ho Chi Minh Sarani, with a bar and a happy hour.

tips.expect: Hotel dining in a calm room.
tips.watch: I couldn't confirm the specific cuisine.
tips.tip: Botanik, the rooftop lounge at the same hotel, is good for sunset.

baan-thai.blurb: Fine-dining Thai at The Oberoi Grand, Kolkata, listed among India's top restaurants by Condé Nast Traveller India (2023) and by La Liste (2025).
dishes: Thai cuisine led by Chef Klae Somsuay

tips.expect: Hand-carved statues, wooden masks, a life-sized Buddha and sunken tables behind carved screens.
tips.good: A real Thai kitchen sourcing ingredients from Thailand.
tips.watch: Lunch is 12:30 to 3 pm and dinner 7 to 11:45 pm. It is expensive.
tips.tip: Book ahead for a special dinner, a short walk from Esplanade.

ozora.blurb: A sky-bar and restaurant on the 20th floor of Acropolis Mall, Kasba, with white furnishings that glow in the evening.

tips.expect: A stylish rooftop with artisanal cocktails and a multi-cuisine menu. About ₹1,000 for two.
tips.good: The view and the rooftop at night.
tips.watch: It is inside a mall, so check closing times.
tips.tip: A good finish after the Kasba pandals.

vintage-asia.blurb: The pan-Asian restaurant at the JW Marriott Kolkata, praised for presentation and service.

tips.expect: Chinese, Japanese and Thai dishes in a fine-dining room. About ₹3,000 for two, rated 4.4.
tips.watch: Expensive, and in the Science City area, away from the pandals.
tips.tip: Better as a special dinner than as a pandal-hopping stop.
